name: Gnocchi à la Romaine
author: Fannie Merritt Farmer (1896)
steps: Melt butter, and when bubbling, add flour, corn-starch, salt, and milk, gradually.
Add yolks of eggs slightly beaten, and one-half cup cheese.
Pour into a buttered shallow pan, and cool.
Turn on a board, cut in squares, diamonds, or strips.
Place on a platter, sprinkle with remaining cheese, and brown in oven.

culture.text: From The Boston Cooking-School Cook Book (1896) by Fannie Merritt Farmer. It popularized level, standardized measurements (cups and spoons) in American home kitchens, and stayed one of the best-selling cookbooks in the United States for decades.
